service.ExecStart: { path=/home/kyau/.local/bin/thermal-guard ; argv[]=/home/kyau/.local/bin/thermal-guard ; ignore_errors=no ; start_time=[n/a] ; stop_time=[n/a] ; pid=0 ; code=(null) ; status=0/0 }

code_semantics.polling: sleep 2 precedes each sample; loop and command duration are additional; first sample follows initial 2-second sleep
code_semantics.sensor_selection: maximum nonnegative integer over thermal_zone types acpitz, TCPU, x86_pkg_temp and all coretemp temp*_input values; no valid sensors yields zero
code_semantics.warning_action: When sampled maximum >=85000 and state normal, read current profile. If not power-saver, attempt powerprofilesctl set power-saver and set changed_profile=1 only on success. Set state=throttled and log warning regardless of command success. Every >=85000 sample resets recovery_samples.
code_semantics.critical_action: At sampled maximum >=95000, emit one critical log per throttle episode; critical flag resets on recovery. alert() is a no-op, so neither warning nor critical generates a desktop alert or stops workloads.
code_semantics.recovery: While throttled, 60 consecutive sampled maxima <=70000; any sample >70000 resets the count. At recovery, attempt balanced only if changed_profile=1. Reset state/flags/counter regardless of restore command success. There is no separate wall-clock minimum hold.
code_semantics.minimum_qualifying_recovery_sampling_not: 60 post-sleep samples require at least 120 seconds from last nonqualifying sample; command/sampling time can extend this. A warning-to-recovered journal gap is not duration spent >=85C.
code_semantics.restore_profile: Always balanced, not saved original profile. If already power-saver before warning, changed_profile stays zero and recovery does not change it.
code_semantics.manual_changes_during_throttled: Profile is requested only at warning transition, not continuously reasserted while throttled. Internal state is in the shell process; current profile alone does not establish latch state.
code_semantics.service_restart: Type simple, on-failure restart after five seconds; script initializes normal/changed_profile=0/recovery_samples=0. No state is persisted across restart.
code_semantics.source_identity_limit: Snapshots establish current on-disk code, active ExecStart and process identity. They do not prove the long-running bash process loaded identical bytes at its October 12 start, nor directly expose shell internal state.
